A changed answer sent with no selected stores selected null; attachAskStates normalises it to [] so the wire never carries null.

deviations: The ask state is attached in the search handler (api/search.go `search`) rather than inside runFusedSearchQuery/runMeaningSearch: the write-time suggestions share runFusedSearchQuery but never use Ask (suggestionFromResult drops it), so the plan's placement cost them extra queries and could drop a write's suggestions on a failed read. attachAskStates decodes rows through docs.ScanAsk (docs.AskColumns) rather than a hand-written copy of its answer/resolution decoding.
